maddeler.e:
نلتظي (form VIII)
# نَلْتَظِي (naltaẓī) /nal.ta.ðˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
# نَلْتَظِيَ (naltaẓiya) /nal.ta.ðˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
